title: Decision challenge: test a choice before you lock it in
summary: A command for your coding agent that pressure-tests one decision before it becomes hard to reverse. You fix weighted criteria first, it writes real alternatives before scoring anything, and then it returns STAY, PIVOT or SPLIT. A SPLIT names the experiment that would settle it.
why: I wrote the first version in March 2026. When I used it on how to publish this site, it kept half my plan and flagged the half that could drift out of step.
